rows.responsibility: Public state and gate contract for the professional Windows console-lock test precondition: four-state classification, fresh non-cached reads, privacy-safe diagnostics, and gating only on a positively locked state.
rows.upstream_owner: tdesktop task-test harness / console-lock interface contract
rows.state_machine: fresh read request -> NotApplicable|Unlocked|Locked|Unknown -> locked() iff Locked -> text diagnostics -> skip gate only when Locked
rows.side_effects: Interface/test-evidence contract only; no product mutation, no clipboard/content capture, no credential access.
rows.failure_cases: Unknown API/metadata state must not be promoted to unlocked; NotApplicable must not gate; legacy Windows reversed flags remain unknown at implementation boundary; diagnostics must not expose user/domain/window-station names.
rows.ui_disposition: TEST/EVIDENCE ONLY. No Telegram-derived production UI. Reuse Fabushi professional cross-platform test/evidence harness.
rows.fabushi_canonical_owner: Canonical cross-platform desktop test precondition/privacy evidence harness
rows.platform_differences: Windows supplies WTS session metadata through the implementation. Non-Windows is explicit NotApplicable. The public contract must preserve Unknown and never infer unlock from inability to read.
rows.production_evidence: Exact accepted header blob read; equivalent Fabushi test-harness state/gate implementation and exact-head evidence remain open.
rows.test_evidence: Four-state fixtures; locked() truth table; ConsoleLockGate empty for Unknown/NotApplicable/Unlocked; diagnostics privacy; fresh-read/no-cache behavior; cross-platform N/A.
rows.reachability_status: accepted-tree exact blob responsibility proven; professional test-harness closure open
